estimate: Difficulty 4/10 · about 200 hours · 1 playthrough · 0 online trophies · no difficulty or medal requirements

stages.text: Turn cheats off — cheats disable trophies and saving. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission: there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus. Most important: meditate at the Chapter 1 spot (Jason's house) as soon as you can — it is the only missable trophy in the list, and it vanishes after Chapter 1.
stages.title: Before you start — saves & the one missable trophy

stages.text: Finish every story mission in Chapters 1–4, then the final mission. All 12 story trophies unlock automatically as you go. While Jason and Lucia are together (from Chapter 2), grab the partner trophy Hot Together. Robbery types open in Chapters 3–4 — try each one as it appears instead of saving them all for later.
stages.title: Stage 1 — Play the story, Chapters 1–4 + finale
stages.trophies: Just Like Paradise, Paradise Lost, T**s Ass Drug Money, Vice City, Baby!, Top Of The World, Ma, You Gotta Know When to Get Off, Trust, Break the Bank, Family Matters, DWNFALL, Hi-Jacked, Snow Storm, Positive Mental Attitude, Hot Together

stages.text: Finish the stranger mission strands: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each have a final-mission trophy, plus Bret's unique-animal hunt. Complete 8 strands in total for the Silver Strangers & Freaks. Strangers stay available in free roam after the story, so work them at your own pace.
stages.title: Stage 2 — Strangers & Freaks
stages.trophies: Road to Rehabilitation, This Was No Boat Accident, The Lone Rider, Supply & Demand, Spin On This!, Strangers & Freaks, Fair Game

stages.text: The big cleanup stage: try all 9 activity types (Master of None), gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges (The Shootist), win 14 drone races and 20 different races, rob 5 bank vaults, an armored truck and one illegal operation per gang (9 gangs), and work the money trophies (launder $250,000, spend $100,000). Check the in-game Progress menu (Touchpad → Progress) to see which of the 80 challenges you still owe for One Last Thing (50 needed).
stages.title: Stage 3 — Activities, robberies & combat
stages.trophies: Master of None, The Shootist, Top Fun, Earn Cash, Not Kudos, Baited My Tackle, Stick Fiddler, One Last Thing, Retail Therapy, Gunslinger, Catch Me If You Can, Challenging Tank, Sneakthief, Maximum Withdrawal, A Classic Blitz Play, Pest Control, Cunning Stunts, Let’s Go Bowling, Personal Best, Actions Speak Louder, Bad Luck, I Guess, The Truth Is Out There, Ten Pin, Dime on the Dollar, Treat Yo Self, On the Spot, In The Beginning…, Capital Offense

stages.text: Finish the collectibles: 3 full card sets, WAiNK at 100 locations, discover 100 vehicles (scan 200 of 277 for the 100% checklist), explore all 52 areas of Leonida — a plane clears the map fog fastest, and one is available early in Chapter 1 — and buy all 8 garage properties.
stages.title: Stage 4 — Collectibles & exploration
stages.trophies: Don't Touch My Deck, You WAiNKer!, Whip It Good, The Goodtime State, Little Boxes

stages.text: Close out the in-game 100% completion checklist for the Gold A Long Road — the hardest trophy, but with lenient thresholds (about 60% of true completion). When it pops, the Platinum Vice Got a Price! follows immediately. Check the Progress menu before the final push so nothing is left uncounted.
stages.title: Stage 5 — 100% completion & the Platinum
stages.trophies: A Long Road, Vice Got a Price!
